name: Agify, Genderize & Nationalize
description:
Three small APIs that make a statistical guess from a first name: age, gender or nationality.

The free tier allows 100 names a day, shared across all three.
auth: None for up to 100 names a day

requests.name: Guess age
requests.description: Predicted age for a name, and how many people the guess is based on.

params.description: Narrow the guess to one country

requests.name: Guess gender
requests.description: Predicted gender for a name, with a probability between 0 and 1.

requests.name: Guess nationality
requests.description: The most likely countries for a name, each with a probability.

requests.name: Several names at once
requests.description: Repeat name[] to guess up to 10 names in one request.
